subject: Offshore subprocessor rotation — backup purge & deletion evidence request
messages:
From: Jared Collins <jared.collins@healthsync.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Megan Lee <megan.lee@procurecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offshore subprocessor rotation — backup purge & deletion evidence request

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Quick context: HealthSync is preparing a security review tied to our upcoming subprocessor rotation in APAC. Procurement asked us to clarify a few items so we can accept Redwood in scope without a full escalation: 

1) Backup purge cadence for APAC-resident snapshots if an offshore subprocessor is removed (we currently see 30d snapshot TTL + 90d archive retention).
2) What concrete deletion evidence we can provide for backups and log streams (forensic logs + manifest). Our auditors prefer a per-subprocessor CSV + signed attestation.
3) Any required DPA addendum language to allow staggered purge windows when a subprocessor is rotated (they want a 14-day staged purge rather than immediate).

Attached is HealthSync's evidence template — please review and tell us what you can reasonably provide and the expected timeline. We need to feed this to legal by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Collins
Head of Security Operations
HealthSync

Attachments: HS_Evidence_Template.pdf (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Collins <jared.collins@healthsync.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offshore subprocessor rotation — backup purge & deletion evidence request

Hi Jared — thanks for the clear ask and the template. High level response and proposed approach below.

Summary of what Redwood can deliver now:
- Subprocessor inventory: we will provide a per-region list and the dates of handoff (CSV).
- Backup purge cadence: we can support a staged purge for subprocessor removal. Proposal: 3-phase staggered purge (soft-retain 0-7d, purge eligible 8-21d, final tombstone/overwrite by 30d) for APAC snapshots when requested in writing. This balances your 14-day preference and our operational safety.
- Deletion evidence: we can provide a manifest showing snapshot IDs + deletion timestamps, a signed attestation from our Privacy team, and an exported KV-log deletion summary. The manifest will match the HealthSync CSV columns.
- DPA addendum language: ops-friendly clause we suggest: "subprocessor removal may trigger a staged purge window of up to 21 days to allow safe snapshot reconciliation and forensic evidence extraction; Redwood will provide deletion manifests and signed attestation within 10 business days of final purge."

Operational caveats and asks from our side: 
- For on-demand immediate purges (customer requires zero-day removal), we need a POA from legal and a runbook signoff; otherwise we default to the staged purge above.
- Evidence extraction for archived snapshots in cold storage may take 3-7 business days depending on export queue; we'll include that as part of the expected timeline.

I attached a quick CSV (proposed-staggered-purge.csv) that maps HealthSync's template to our manifest fields. Ben / Kimberly: can you confirm technical feasibility and any expected delays for KV log exports?

Next steps: if Jared confirms, I will circulate a short DPA addendum draft and a DocuSign request.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. PM, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-staggered-purge.csv (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offshore subprocessor rotation — backup purge & deletion evidence request

Marissa — quick technical readout:

- Snapshot purge: implementing the 3-phase schedule is doable. We tag snapshots with the subprocessor id at creation; removal workflow already marks snapshots for staged deletion. We need to ensure the archive overwrite job respects the 21d window. Estimated dev ops work: 2 engineer-days to add explicit tombstone + audit event.
- KV-log export: we can export deletion manifests per-subprocessor. Export pipeline currently batches small runs nightly; to meet a 10-business-day attestation window we need to add a prioritized extract path. Ops impact: schedule a prioritized export job for customers with active rotation — ~1 engineer-day to enable.
- Cold storage retrieval: depends on the cloud provider retrieval SLA — currently 3-5 days typical.

I attached an internal technical note with the current log/export behavior. Kimberly, can you draft suggested DPA wording that maps to the technical constraints above? I recommend leaning conservative on timelines.

—Ben

Attachments: technical-notes-backup-kvlog.txt (stub)

Subject: Re: Offshore subprocessor rotation — backup purge & deletion evidence request

Marissa / Ben — this looks reasonable, appreciate the detail. A couple quick clarifying points before I push to legal procurement: 

- Can you confirm the signed attestation will be delivered within 10 business days of final purge? That is our minimum ask for the vendor attestation clause.
- For archive retrieval: please state the retrieval SLA in the addendum (we can accept 5–7 business days).

If you can finalize the DPA addendum text and drop a DocuSign link by tomorrow EOD, procurement will route for signature. Once signed, we'll share the rotation schedule and we expect Redwood to follow the staged purge timeline for the specified subprocessor.

Thanks — looking forward to the DocuSign.

Best,
Jared
Head of Security Operations, HealthSync
